d:
Short, choppy ash blonde hair with a messy, wind-swept texture. Round, wide-eyed bright blue eyes with a playful expression. Appears as a youthful teenager with soft features. Petite and athletic build. A white and navy blue sailor-style outfit featuring a short pleated skirt and a nautical necktie. A oversized white sailor cap perched precariously on the head and heavy grey mechanical rigging with naval cannons.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
